name: Nutrition Management Services Company
summary: Nutrition Management Services Company (NMSCA) specializes in delivering comprehensive dietary, nutritional, and operational management services across the United States. Their offerings extend to include specialized environmental oversight and efficient cook-chill food preparation solutions. The company caters to a diverse range of organizations, serving various senior living and long-term care settings such as independent and assisted living facilities, continuing care retirement communities, and nursing homes. Additionally, they support healthcare institutions like acute care hospitals, rehabilitation centers, and specialized psychiatric and chemical dependency treatment facilities, alongside independent educational institutions. Established in 1979, NMSCA is headquartered in Kimberton, Pennsylvania.
